thread:
Nina P: Follow-up from RFC: proposing debounce + affinity lease for short streaming calls. goal: keep KV hits without long sticky tails.

Rahul V: Nice. Key constraints: short TTL (15s), debounce on affinity attempts (500ms) to avoid thrash during reconnects, and per-tenant sticky budget to avoid hot tenants.

Eli H: Ops: must emit canonical_fingerprint=v3 with tenant_salt so backfills can deterministically join even after rewrite. Also include origin_shard and served_via header.

Nina P: Proposed event contract snippet:
```json
{ "tenant_id":"t_999","session_id":"sess-42","canonical_fingerprint":"cfp:v3:sha256:tenantSalt:deadbeef","seq_in_session":12,"ingest_ts":"2026-03-22T18:00:01Z","served_via":"sticky","origin_shard":"a-21","payload_tokens":120 }
```

Rahul V: Reconciler design: sidecar consumer reads raw-ingest topic, groups by canonical_fingerprint and seq, emits correction messages to billing-corrections topic when gaps/duplicates found. Corrections include reason_code (e.g., "stale-lease-eviction", "cross-az-fallback", "late-arrival").

Eli H: Late arrival window: increase to 48h for high variance customers; corrections older than window are still emitted but marked 'post-window' and routed to finance-review.

Nina P: Affinity debounce notes: when connection drops and reconnects within 500ms, reuse lease if worker still active; otherwise new lease. This reduces churn on short reconnects from mobile clients.

Rahul V: Hot-tenant protections: per-worker sticky_bytes_limit and sticky_session_limit. Router should refuse lease if (worker.sticky_bytes + session_est_bytes) > sticky_bytes_limit. Metric: affinity_reject_count{tenant}.

Eli H: Failover labeling: if request served by non-origin worker, add headers: served_via="fallback", fallback_origin="a-21", fallback_reason="zone-outage" and leave canonical_fingerprint unchanged.

Nina P: Rollout: start with internal tenants, 1-week canary, compare token_cost_p95, kv_hit_ratio, affinity_reject_rate, correction_rate. Turn on per-tenant config in feature flags.

Rahul V: Testing checklist: chaos tests for zone outage, synthetic bursts to test sticky eviction, end-to-end backfill to ensure reconciler rebuilds billing table.

Eli H: Ops runbook: how to reconcile tenant when corrections spike: stop sticky for tenant, run backfill job, run reconcile with force-correct flag, notify finance.

infra-bot: Feature flag 'affinity-debounce' created and scheduled for canary on next canary deploy.
